mapper.select: SELECT * from device where user_id=#{userId} order by id desc
SELECT * from device where user_id=#{userId} and iot_id=#{iotId} limit 1
SELECT * from device where iot_id=#{iotId} limit 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device ( user_id, iot_id, dev_name, dev_type, status, description, dev_secret, create_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{iotId}, #{devName}, #{devType}, #{status}, #{description}, #{devSecret}, #{createTime} )
mapper.update: update device set dev_name=#{devName},dev_type=#{devType},status=#{status},description=#{description} where iot_id=#{iotId} and user_id=#{userId}
